result:
Comments are in place: signed-in users can comment on posts, delete their own or on their own posts, and report comments. Three reports hide a comment from the post page while keeping its row. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (8 tests, 6 of them pre-existing or new comment tests passing) and `bunx guren gate` all pass.

I added a `comments` table and a `comment_reports` table with a unique (`comment_id`, `user_id`) index, in migration `20261018230755_comments`. The endpoints follow the contract: `POST /posts/:id/comments`, `DELETE /comments/:id` (403 for anyone other than the comment's author or the post's author), and `POST /comments/:id/report` (204, repeat reports counted once). The `posts/Show` props gained `comments`, oldest first, with hidden comments left out. Deleting a post removes its comments and their reports.

The new tests in `tests/CommentController.test.ts` cover the guest redirect, the 422 on a blank comment, listing order, delete permissions, the three-reporter hide, and cascade on post delete. I did not exercise the post page in a browser. The Report button uses an Inertia `Link` that receives a 204, and I have not confirmed the page behaves well with that response.

Changes are in `db/schema.ts`, the new `Comment`/`CommentReport` models, `CommentPolicy`, `CommentController` and its validator and resource, `PostController` (`show` and `destroy`), `routes/web.ts`, and `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx`, plus regenerated `.guren/*.gen.ts`.
